title: Mod page content
description: Contract for edges E3 (author -> N2, page.json PRs, ADR-0059 Section 2-3) and E10 (N2 -> N7, the site build's read side, together with entry.schema.json) in docs/architecture/depgraph.md. One instance is the full page-content document for one mod, stored at mods/<namespace>.<name>/page.json (README.md). Unlike entry.json, this document is NOT append-only: ADR-0059 Section 2 calls it "immediately editable" content, and Section 3: "Approved page changes publish immediately; git history is the audit trail." Every field here may be freely replaced by a later page.json PR -- contracts/append-only.rules.md's immutability rules apply only to entry.json and explicitly do not reach this file.

screenshots.description: ADR-0059 Section 2: page content field "screenshots[]". Each entry is a path, never an absolute URL: pages are built from the archived source, never the live web (ADR-0059 Section 1), so a screenshot can only ever be a file that was actually archived alongside the mod, addressed relative to the archive root -- the same way contracts/validation-report.schema.json's own path fields are POSIX-style paths relative to a root.

items.description: A POSIX-style relative path inside the archived mod source (e.g. "assets/screenshots/shop.png"). Rejected if it contains a URL scheme ("...://..."), starts with "/" (an absolute filesystem path), contains a backslash (a Windows-style absolute path), or contains a ".." path-traversal segment (a whole path segment equal to "..", anywhere in the path -- e.g. "../etc/passwd" or "a/../../etc/passwd") -- ADR-0059 Section 1. Two dots that are merely part of a longer segment, such as "a..b/c.png" or "screenshots/v1.2.3.png", are not a traversal segment and remain valid (task 034).

links.description: ADR-0059 Section 2: page content field "links[]" (e.g. Discord, wiki, documentation). Unlike `screenshots`, these are genuinely external and MAY be absolute URLs -- they point off-site by nature, not at archived files. Shape ({label, url}) is not specified by any ADR read for this task; booked under Questions in docs/tasks/006-contracts.md.

url.description: An absolute URL (any scheme). Deliberately the opposite constraint from `screenshots` -- a link is expected to leave the site; a screenshot is expected never to.

deprecated.description: ADR-0059 Section 2: page content field "deprecated". ADR-0041: authors may mark a mod deprecated ("shown; new dependencies warned") but this never removes or blocks existing versions -- it is page content, editable at any time, distinct from a version's own `status` (entry.schema.json), which only the pipeline writes.
